longer blade → lower false-fill rate (linear scale, 1 → 0; ties broken by row F1)
blades sorted best → worst, left → right

villain metrics = six-paper subsets of complete full sweeps pooled with dedicated villain-only sweeps (same paper mix); never pooled into the full-13 leaderboard · (v-only) arms exist only as villain sweeps (no full-13 counterpart)

false-fill rate on the six rogue papers · whiskers = ±1 between-sweep SD (multi-sweep arms) · other uncapped whisker ends = ±SD reaches past the axis edge, clamped · Qianfan-OCR (32) sits at the axis origin (false-fill rate 1.000): zero-length blade drawn as a stub
gray stubs = negative results, not scored (EXAONE-4.5-33B & Fara1.5-9B: no protocol drive)
